- Identify indices divisible by 3 (i.e., 0-based indices where i % 3 == 0); extract their values into a list and sort that list ascending.
- Iterate through the original list; for indices not divisible by 3, keep the element; for indices divisible by 3, replace with the next element from the sorted extracted list (maintaining order).
- Construct and return the resulting list, ensuring list length and non-divisible positions remain unchanged.
